Package neqsim.thermo.util.sulfur

Class SulfurThermodynamics

java.lang.Object
neqsim.thermo.util.sulfur.SulfurThermodynamics
public final class SulfurThermodynamics extends Object
Thermodynamic correlations for elemental sulfur used by sulfur-recovery equipment.

Gas-phase sulfur is treated as an ideal reacting mixture of S2 through S8. The equilibrium calculation minimizes the ideal-gas Gibbs energy subject to a single sulfur-atom balance. Reference enthalpies and entropies are from the NIST-JANAF Thermochemical Tables, fourth edition (Chase, 1998). Heat capacities for S2-S7 are constant reference values; S8 uses the NIST Shomate correlation. This is a considerably better representation than treating all sulfur vapour as S8, while keeping the calculation independent of cubic-EOS pseudo-component parameters.

The vapour-pressure correlation interpolates the reviewed sulfur vapour-pressure table reported by Meyer (1976), based on Jensen, Baker, and Rau. Interpolation is linear in ln(P) versus 1/T, which is locally consistent with the Clausius-Clapeyron equation. No extrapolation is performed beyond 312.15-1308.15 K.

  • Method Details

    • calculateAllotropeMoleFractions

      public static Map<String,Double> calculateAllotropeMoleFractions(double temperatureK, double sulfurPartialPressureBar)
      Calculate equilibrium mole fractions of sulfur vapour allotropes.

      The supplied pressure is the total partial pressure of elemental sulfur vapour, not the total process pressure. The returned fractions therefore sum to one over S2-S8.

      Parameters:
      temperatureK - temperature [K]
      sulfurPartialPressureBar - total elemental-sulfur vapour partial pressure [bar]
      Returns:
      unmodifiable map keyed by S2 through S8
